name: Luxury Reflection
description: Premium photography with elegant reflective surface
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Display the product on a pristine white surface with a highly reflective liquid glass finish that creates a clear, slightly distorted mirror reflection. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only add the liquid glass reflective surface and modify lighting around the unchanged product.
